standard_prerequisites: LK derivations and the right universal quantifier rule
the eigenvariable condition on constants in R forall inferences
finiteness of derivations giving a finite premise set Gamma_0
core_obligations: Prove that if c occurs in neither Gamma nor A(x) and Gamma proves A(c), then Gamma proves the universal closure forall x A(x)
proof_roadmap: Take a finite Gamma_0 contained in Gamma with an LK derivation of the sequent Gamma_0 sequent A(c)
Append one right-universal inference; since c occurs in neither Gamma_0 nor A(x), the eigenvariable condition holds, yielding a derivation of Gamma_0 sequent forall x A(x)
This is a derivation of forall x A(x) from Gamma
difficulty_reason: A one-inference extension of a given derivation; the check is exactly the eigenvariable condition, which must be applied correctly.
